entries.020829ec95318d72: Under its management philosophy of 'Being Useful to People', the group states that through the manufacture of safety visibility technologies, led by automotive rearview mirrors and mirrors for head-up displays, it will contribute to realizing a safe, secure and comfortable society. For sustainable growth, it is also working on developing new business domains and diversifying its businesses, and over the medium to long term it aims to grow by optimizing the entire supply chain and transforming its earnings structure, and through strategic investment based on selection and concentration and the creation of new technologies and products.
entries.08a46f29aa8a22f9: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥115,651 million, up 5.9% year on year. By location, revenue was ¥51,306 million in Japan, ¥33,104 million in Asia and ¥31,240 million in North America, and higher sales volumes in Thailand and Mexico and the effect of exchange rates contributed to the revenue increase.
